adaptations: Standalone Vemal's Ears landing/privacy pages and downloads; no Downtime product downloads.
Relay wire protocol, voice membership gate and credential storage retain the upstream implementation.
Removed hosted-addon job CLI commands; retained upstream credential database schema for compatibility.

Host transfer rendezvous: /v1/transfer-offer and /v1/transfer-claim, present only with VEMALS_EARS_TRANSFER_KEY_FILE; opaque piping in memory, and a freeze that refuses pairing and viewer-link binds only. The freeze is confirmed only after viewer-link writes admitted before it have landed (bounded wait; an overrun reports not frozen). The offer socket can also ask for the planned-maintenance announcement before the old Host stops.

Release pointer: release_pointer_from_bytes() holds the pointer validation that load_release_pointer() now calls (unchanged behaviour), so a host transfer can check a received pointer against its mirrored downloads, or only its shape in transit.
